steps.text: Talk to Ffion to be allowed onto the island.
Talk to Cormac in Auchrie village on Wyrmscraig island.
Talk to Muriel in the house north east of Cormac.
Search the tent to the south east on the coast for a pickaxe.
Search the tent to the south east on the coast for a hammer.
Search the tent to the south east on the coast for a chisel.
Search the tent to the south east on the coast for a pickaxe, hammer, and chisel.
Inspect the sunstone monolith on the coast south east of Muriel.
Mine a sunstone fragment off the sunstone monolith.
Use a chisel on the sunstone fragment.
Investigate the large hat on a basalt column on the south west corner of the island.
Return to Cormac in Auchrie village on Wyrmscraig island.
Sail into the cave on the south west of the island with either a skiff or a raft.
Disembark onto the gangplank and talk to Mortimer.
Kill the 3 trolls near to Mortimer.
Talk to Mortimer again.
Investigate the broken golem in the far north of the cavern.
Use your sunstone core on the broken golem.
Unlock the chest in the north west of the northern room. The code is 'RIGHT, LEFT, DOWN, DOWN'.
Right-click destroy the ancient sunstone core.
Climb the staircase, ready for the boss fight.
Defeat the Mad Angel. Read the sidebar for more details.

Defeat the Mad Angel. Use Protect from Melee. If she pulls her sword back slowly, run behind her. If she charges a blue attack, protect from magic. If you activate it the tick it hits you, you get a guaranteed max hit on her next hit. If she launches a projectile at a tile, stand on the tile to bounce it back to her.
Search the body in the church.
Read the final letter.
Return to Cormac to finish the quest.

rewards: Access to Sunstone Golem Crafting & Mining
Teleports to Wyrmscraig on the Slayer Ring and Necklace of Passage
